scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Statement covers only characteristic two and cyclic length at least three. It establishes set-theoretic algebra endomorphisms, finite-field cardinalities, the ideal lattice and splitting; it does not classify nonreduced endomorphism schemes or odd-characteristic analogues. Full publication priority is not certified. Exhaustive small finite-field tests corroborate but cannot prove the uniform statement.
title: A rank gap and parity transition in endomorphism monoids of singular Cayley evolution algebras
